post_collision.interval_assumptions: Independent Gaussian seed, episode and residual effects; conservative Bonferroni variance-component interval. Not exact for bounded/catastrophic outcomes; five pairs leave wide uncertainty. Zero empirical variance does not establish zero population variance.

tracked_frac.interval_assumptions: Independent Gaussian seed, episode and residual effects; conservative Bonferroni variance-component interval. Not exact for bounded/catastrophic outcomes; five pairs leave wide uncertainty. Zero empirical variance does not establish zero population variance.

gate.note: Statistical component only. Parent launch gate must verify all signoff conditions; uncertainty interval is reported separately.

methodological_variance_status: NOT_MEASURED_BY_THIS_PILOT: CL-minus-OL variance is a conservative planning transfer, not hybrid-minus-classic or hybrid-minus-BPTT variance evidence.
uncertainty_release_note: Point rule and fixed boundary neighborhood govern; the wide model-based interval is not silently substituted as a new gate. Point pass does not prove power or trainability.
